title: World Fuel Announces Acquisition of Branded Fuel Dealer Contracts from CF Altitude LLC
summary: World Fuel announced today the acquisition of branded fuel dealer contracts from CF Altitude LLC in Missouri and Illinois. Read the full story.
body_markdown:
**RELEASE DATE: September 2, 2026**


**CONTACT**
**World Fuel**
Pete Stevens, +1 281-280-2114,[\[email protected\]](https://pstevens@worldfuel.com/)


**September 2, 2026 – HOUSTON** – World Fuel announced today the acquisition of branded fuel dealer contracts from CF Altitude LLC in Missouri and Illinois.


“This acquisition reinforces our footprint in the St. Louis area and strengthens our distribution network to serve branded fuel retailers throughout the Midwest. Combined with our extensive supply network and longstanding relationships across all major fuel branding programs, we are ideally situated to provide customers with continuity, flexibility, and trusted support,” said Bob Kenyon, senior vice president, Retail, Wholesale and Supply Chain. ****


"We appreciate the collaboration of CF Altitude LLC throughout this transition and their commitment to ensuring customers remain well-positioned for success. We welcome our new customers and are committed to delivering dependable supply, exceptional service, and industry expertise to help retailers grow and succeed over the long term.” ****


For nearly two decades, World Fuel has offered a broad portfolio of major oil brands, quality fuel delivery, and services to help more than 3,000 independent convenience store and truck stop owners across the United States grow their businesses.


***


**About World Fuel**


Headquartered in Miami, Florida, World Fuel is a leading global provider of aviation, marine, and ground-based transportation fuels and complementary services. Through an integrated global supply and logistics network, it sources and distributes products and services to meet customer needs across more than 200 countries and territories throughout the world, including lower-carbon fuels to support customers' energy-transition objectives. In the United States, the Company also markets natural gas and related solutions.


For more information, visit[www.worldfuel.com](http://www.worldfuel.com/) .
